description: Turn any topic into a narrated whiteboard animation video without leaving ChatGPT. Describe what you want explained, and Whiteboard Video Maker writes the script, draws each scene with a hand-drawn whiteboard animation and adds a natural voiceover. Choose the length, landscape (YouTube) or portrait (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), the narration language and the voice. Videos render in a few minutes; ask whether your video is ready to get the MP4 download link and thumbnail. You can also list your recent videos and check your credit balance. Requires a Whiteboard Video account; videos use the account's credits (1 credit per minute) and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before creating one.
